host.ask: IP address or host name of the furnace controller's communication module
host.help: Shown on the controller under Settings / Ethernet (or printed as the hostname N<serial> on the module); DHCP with a reservation or a fixed address. Port 502 is assumed; put `port` in config.json if your network maps it elsewhere.

unit.help: 1 on every controller this package was written for; change only if Nabertherm service set another.
